Source hashes remain unchanged; no fresh full-suite coverage PASS is inferred from unchanged bytes or a forecast.

R5 explicitly still requires current spec approval, implementation begin and a separately independently reviewed fresh exact single-use native action before the complete native rerun; then genuine current stable-snapshot implementation review, same-verifier finalization, code approval, Gate and exact-head required source CI. Node CI and real target application remain later overall-goal stages, and source authority does not transfer to the target. No system-temp spill, private upload, paid/model/product call, credentials, deployment, deletion, settings change or threshold reduction is introduced.

No current design finding remains in this narrow refrozen follow-up; APPROVE is DESIGN only. I authored none of the production or test changes under review. This record grants no spec/action/code approval, begin/verify/consumption, formal implementation or source snapshot acceptance, native PASS, Gate or completed integration.
